audit_boundary: Frozen consumer-admission audit. In ADR03-ADR06 the TaskSpec makes consumer inventory and consumer contracts packet-prohibited reviewer observations; any root result from the design container that contains or does not prove exclusion of those projections is mixed-owner admission. Direct reviewer reads of those projections are required, and a root preread plus reviewer read is duplicate consumption. Explicit reviewer final statements are used only to establish observed prohibited packet delivery; encrypted spawn payloads are not inferred. ADR07 and ADR09 require exactly one paired-scope target read and no design-container or outside reviewer read. Base reviewer cardinality, result admission/effect, terminal, command, and forbidden-input predicates remain binding.
